summary: T-0686 (P1 capstone T-0647, wave 5): invert the schema-editor per-field «Ключ↔Название». BEFORE: the machine KEY was the FIRST, MANDATORY column ('Ключ: Укажите ключ поля') and the human «Название» was placeholder-marked OPTIONAL — rank-and-file users hand-wrote a latin key per field (field-level «слаг-ад»). AFTER: «Название» is PRIMARY + REQUIRED (first, widest column); the KEY auto-derives from it and is shown SlugField-style («ключ: X · изменить») in the field's sub-row, optionally hand-editable. Reuses T-0650 (imports transliterate from slug-field-logic.js — the SAME canonical Cyrillic→latin map the SlugField preview mirrors from src/core/slug-generator.ts; deriveFieldKeyFromTitle emits snake_case since a FIELD KEY is a record-data property name governed by FIELD_KEY_RE /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}$/ — underscores, NOT the kebab-case app/set slug). In-set collision suffix (base, base_2) via uniqueFieldKey mirrors insertWithUniqueSlugRetry's numbered strategy, client-side (no per-field server endpoint; keys are property names in one whole record_schema). Explicit hand-written keys continue to be FIELD_KEY_RE-validated (backward-compat). STABLE-KEY INVARIANT proven: withAutoFieldKeys only fills EMPTY keys — a keyed field (existing field loaded via parseRecordSchema, or one the author already keyed) is never re-derived, so renaming a field's title never changes its stored key and never orphans records.
deviations_from_adr: No separate ADR/spec authored — small UX-inversion task explicitly scoped to reuse T-0650 (per task brief 'переиспользуй T-0650, не выдумывай новое'). Design decisions documented inline in code comments (apps-schema.js deriveFieldKeyFromTitle/uniqueFieldKey/withAutoFieldKeys headers + screen-app-schema.jsx FieldKeyPreview header) and in this handoff.

Scope kept to TOP-LEVEL field keys. Collection sub-field (column) keys still require a manual key in CollectionSubFieldEditor — same «slug-ad» pattern one level down, but a secondary path; left untouched to keep the change focused and reversible. Flagged as a follow-up (see friction_events).
friction_events: KEY-FORMAT FRICTION (the load-bearing finding): the app/набор SLUG (T-0650) is kebab-case (SLUG_FIELD_RE /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$/, dashes), but a per-field KEY is a JSON/record-data PROPERTY name governed by a DIFFERENT grammar FIELD_KEY_RE /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}$/ (underscores, NO dashes, no leading digit). So previewSlugFromName ('summa-avansa') would produce an INVALID field key. Resolution: reuse only the T-0650 transliterate() building block and emit snake_case ('summa_avansa'); the collision suffix is '_2' (underscore), not '-2' (dash). A digit-leading title (e.g. '2 дня') is prefixed with the generic fallback ('field_2_dnya') to stay valid. Backend expects underscores (snake_case), confirmed against FIELD_KEY_RE + the seed property names.
